review.scope: Only three context-construction paths, pinned SDK route/default behavior and the necessary fence companion capability. All backend proof and PLAN-A1..A5 are reused unchanged; no fourth broad review.

author_hold.outcome: The Service Worker prerequisite gap is real; author correctly stopped before implementation.

confirmed_contract.route_limit: Pinned Playwright1.61.1 Page.route and BrowserContext.route exclude requests intercepted by a Service Worker. A route-based unconditional admission fence therefore needs an enforced worker-blocking prerequisite in every relevant context.
confirmed_contract.default: The installed stock serviceWorkers option resolves contextOptions.serviceWorkers ?? 'allow' and forwards it into combined context options. Direct Browser.newContext also defaults to allow.

three_actual_paths.current: Normal resourcePage delegates the stock page/context. Neither project config nor calendar test.use blocks Service Workers; no downstream enforced block was identified.
Attached path explicitly calls browser.newContext with optional baseURL only. It does not inherit stock test.use context options and requires an explicit block option.
E2E007 explicitly calls newContext on the same owned browser with baseURL/viewport/touch options only. It requires its own explicit block option.

confirmed_contract.limits: Fresh context, empty serviceWorkers() inventory or no current registration source is not permanent denial of later registration. No active worker or worker-caused observed abort is alleged.

recommended_narrow_variant.stock_context: Add serviceWorkers:'block' to the existing calendar test.use({trace:'off',screenshot:'off',video:'off'}) at calendar-feed.e2e.spec.ts:31. The installed test-option fixture then supplies the block to the stock calendar context, without changing unrelated E2E defaults.
recommended_narrow_variant.attached_context: Add serviceWorkers:'block' to the existing attached browser.newContext options, preserving both optional-baseURL branches and all context/page/browser identities and lifecycle/error/close order.
recommended_narrow_variant.phone_context: Add serviceWorkers:'block' to the existing E2E007 browser.newContext options alongside unchanged baseURL,360x640 viewport and hasTouch; preserve all assertions, callback/context identity and close order.

proposed_global_variant.judgment: Adding the same block to existing global use is a bounded valid way to cover the stock path if Coordinator intentionally allocates that shared test-policy change. It is not strictly necessary or uniquely minimal: the existing calendar test.use provides the narrower option site in a path already needed for the explicit phone context. The global option affects unrelated stock E2E contexts and should be described honestly.
proposed_global_variant.hunk_limit: Only serviceWorkers:'block' at existing use; preserve all commands, reporters, projects, timeouts, environment, contexts, selectors and assertions.

minimal_capability_and_hunks.authority: Root/Coordinator chooses and actually allocates the exact five- or six-path scope before source implementation. This validation itself authorizes no edit, test, browser or resource.

fence_requirements_still_mandatory.PLAN_A1_A5: All existing per-Request ledger/admission, exact commit certificate, frontend/backend separation, continuation ownership, other-work/custody and integrity-test conditions remain mandatory. Worker blocking supplies routing coverage only; it does not implement or prove the fence.
fence_requirements_still_mandatory.context_coverage: Use a context-wide fence for the owned multi-page flow; page-only routing does not cover competing pages/popups.
fence_requirements_still_mandatory.fault_routing: Current helper armFault uses page.route and direct route.continue/route.fetch. Page routes take precedence over context routes, and continue sends immediately without lower matching handlers. These existing dispatch paths must consult and update the SAME ledger/fence before every backend dispatch; no route path may bypass admission because a context route exists. Preserve fault semantics, body/disposal ownership and all preexisting guards.
fence_requirements_still_mandatory.controls: Use the already owned wrapper-unit actual-source seams to verify option propagation/construction and missing-or-allow inverses on all relevant context paths, plus existing PLAN-A1 late-dispatch controls. No new test file, generic matrix, standalone collector or runtime is required for this scope validation.
fence_requirements_still_mandatory.stop: If another concrete creation/dispatch bypass is discovered outside allocated paths, stop with that exact bypass before editing. Do not substitute a worker snapshot, silently widen the scope or relax custody.

commands.scope: Hash-bound actual companion sites and exact SDK defaults/route contract reads.
Existing helper fault routes and exact SDK routing priority/continue contract only.

conclusion: The actual prerequisite is serviceWorkers:block in all three relevant context creation paths. The proposed six-path solution is valid if explicitly allocated; a narrower five-path solution achieves the same prerequisite without a global config edit. No implementation or unconditional fence PASS is granted.
